title: FrontDesk AI — Cost & Workflow Legs
description: Time and cost per request, broken down by workflow leg and specialist desk, per participant namespace. The cost rate is derived live from the gateway's own billing rather than hardcoded. Queries the NUC Prometheus (uid prometheus-nuc).

panels.title: Cost per request
panels.description: Total tokens x the gateway's own blended rate, over requests handled. This is the number Module 7 says to put a ceiling on.

targets.expr: sum(frontdeskai_llm_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * scalar(sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total)) / sum(frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Cost per 1,000 requests
panels.description: The same number at a scale you can argue about in a planning meeting. Six decimal places is not a budget.

targets.expr: sum(frontdeskai_llm_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * scalar(sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total)) / sum(frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * 1000
sum(frontdeskai_llm_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / sum(frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Seconds per request
panels.description: Mean end-to-end. Time and cost are different bills paid by different legs — that is what the rest of this dashboard is for.

targets.expr: sum(frontdeskai_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / sum(frontdeskai_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: LLM calls per request
panels.description: Every leg of the workflow is a billable call. Fan-out is the cost lever you control most directly.

targets.expr: sum(frontdeskai_llm_call_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / sum(frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Gateway rate
panels.description: USD per MILLION tokens, derived live from the gateway's own spend divided by its own token count — nothing is hardcoded here. Blended across input and output, because the app records total tokens only.

targets.expr: scalar(sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total)) * 1e6

panels.title: Cost of each leg, per request
panels.description: The pipeline as it actually runs: the supervisor classifies, the worker's ReAct loop reads tools, a failed tool call falls back, the worker writes the answer, and the manager takes it if it escalates. Each box shows USD per request spent in that leg. A leg with no traffic reads 0.

panels.title: Which specialist desk the money goes to
Spend by desk (USD)
panels.description: Worker spend only. The supervisor and the manager belong to no desk and are excluded, so this total is LESS than the app total — the routing and escalation legs are on the leg breakdown above.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (desk) (label_replace(sum by (agent) (frontdeskai_llm_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace", agent!~"supervisor|manager"}), "desk", "$1", "agent", "([a-z]+)_(?:react_iter|worker).*")) * scalar(sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total)))

panels.title: Requests routed to each desk
panels.description: Read together with the bar on the left. A desk taking few requests but most of the spend is the one to look at first.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (category) (frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: Spend rate by leg
panels.description: USD per hour at the current rate, stacked by leg. Useful for seeing a change land, not for forecasting a bill.

panels.title: Cost per request over time
panels.description: The number to watch after a prompt change. Cost per case moves quietly when a prompt grows.

targets.expr: sum(rate(frontdeskai_llm_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) * scalar(sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total)) / sum(rate(frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cost per request, by participant
panels.description: Select All in the Participant variable to compare. Everyone is running the same app against the same model, so a large spread is a difference in prompts, tools or traffic — not in the platform.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (namespace) (frontdeskai_llm_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * scalar(sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total)) / sum by (namespace) (frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: Total app spend, by participant
panels.description: Attributed from the app's own token counter, so this is the deployed app only.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (namespace) (frontdeskai_llm_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * scalar(sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total)))

panels.title: App spend (derived)
panels.description: From the app's own per-agent token counter. Resets when the pod restarts.

targets.expr: sum(frontdeskai_llm_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * scalar(sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total))

panels.title: Key spend (gateway)
panels.description: What the gateway has billed this participant's key. It includes their NOTEBOOK work as well as the app, so it should be LARGER than the derived figure — if it is smaller, the derivation is wrong.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace) (label_replace(sum by (api_key_alias) (litellm_spend_metric_total), "namespace", "agenticaiu$1", "api_key_alias", "agenticai-[0-9]+-u([0-9]+)")) and on(namespace) (frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"} > bool -1))
sum(frontdeskai_category_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Share of the $2.50 daily cap
panels.description: Each participant key is capped at $2.50/day. Over budget the gateway returns HTTP 400 rather than falling back, so this is worth watching during a long session.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace) (label_replace(sum by (api_key_alias) (litellm_spend_metric_total), "namespace", "agenticaiu$1", "api_key_alias", "agenticai-[0-9]+-u([0-9]+)"))) / 2.5

panels.title: How the cost number is built

options.content:
**There is no price list in this dashboard.** The rate comes from the gateway's own accounting —
`sum(litellm_spend_metric_total) / sum(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total)` — so it re-derives itself
if the tariff changes. Per-leg cost is then that rate times the tokens the app attributes to each
agent. Three consequences worth knowing before you quote a number from here:

- **It is a blended input/output rate.** The app records total tokens per call, not the split, so a
  leg with an unusual input:output ratio is approximated. The *ranking* of legs is solid; the
  absolute figure is an estimate.
- **"Per request" means per request on average.** Prometheus stores aggregates. For one specific
  request — which agent, in what order, how long each took — the span tree is in Grafana's Explore
  under the **Tempo** datasource, service name `frontdeskai-<your namespace>`.
- **Counters reset when the pod restarts**, so a redeploy is a clean experiment boundary: change one
  thing, replay the same cases, compare cost per request before and after.

**Module 7's point, in one line:** cost per case is a gate, not a report. Pick the ceiling while
nobody is under pressure, and fail the build on it — and remember the leg that costs the most and
the leg that takes the longest are usually different legs, so know which one you were asked to fix.
